title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-27
source: Matrix 60% soundboard/40% audience; sources: 1 - SBD>Cass/1>DAT>HD-P2>Soundforge 6.0>Flac Frontend>FLAC  (shnid 78746) Tranfer by Jake Clemens 2 - (FOB) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B) (shnid 102570) Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show highlighted by a monster nine‑minute Other One, captured on a well‑balanced matrix mix that’s crisp though the audience is a bit loud.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about an impressive, smoking performance anchored by a spectacular nine‑minute stretch of The Other One. The matrix source provides a lively feel with a nicely mastered mix—Jerry’s guitar sits forward and the overall balance is solid, despite the audience being slightly louder than ideal.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average 4.5) and uniformly enthusiastic comments about both the show’s energy and the matrix recording quality justify a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced mix with Jerry louder in front, mastering by Charlie Miller praised; audience spill is noticeable but not detrimental.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall flow described as smoking and energetic; the show feels cohesive and engaging.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar is louder in the mix and his tone is appreciated by reviewers.
